title: Aid to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS): Medical and Burial Assistance
description: Medical or burial assistance from the Dipolog City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) for indigent residents in crisis.
department: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Residents of Dipolog City, indigents only

items: Barangay Certification signed by the Barangay Chairman certifying that the bearer is in dire need of assistance and belongs to an indigent/low-income family
Medical Certificate from the hospital where the patient was confined
CSWDO Intake Form, signed by the client (accomplished with the designated staff)
Barangay Certification signed by the Barangay Chairman certifying that the bearer is in dire need of assistance and belongs to an indigent/low-income family
Death Certificate of the deceased
CSWDO Intake Form, signed by the client (accomplished with the designated staff)

procedures.providerAction: Interview the client to get important information.

procedures.clientAction: Submit all required documents and sign the Intake Form.
procedures.providerAction: Review the documents and prepare them for the City Mayor's signature, then notify the client of the approval of the assistance by letter or other means.

contact.location: CSWDO, Brgy. Sta. Isabel (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 10 minutes, plus the time for the City Mayor's approval. No fee is listed for this service.

Patients referred by hospitals can also ask the CSWDO for a referral letter or social case study report (Barangay Certification of indigency and Medical Certificate required; medical abstract optional).

title: Person with Disability (PWD) ID
description: Apply for or replace a PWD Identification Card at the Dipolog City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO).
department: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Persons with disability who are residents of Dipolog City

items: Birth Certificate or Baptismal Certificate
Income Tax Return (if any)
Certificate of Residency from the Barangay Captain
Two (2) copies of 1x1 ID picture
Accomplished membership information sheet (c/o the PWD Center)
Affidavit of Loss
Barangay or police blotter

procedures.providerAction: Interview the person with disability to get pertinent information.

procedures.clientAction: Fill out the application form and submit the required documents.
procedures.providerAction: Receive the application form and documents.
Approve the application, sign the identification card and release the ID.

contact.location: CSWDO, Brgy. Sta. Isabel (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 12 minutes and 45 seconds. No fee is listed.
With the PWD ID, you can get a purchase slip/booklet from the CSWDO for discounts on medicines.

schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Residents of Dipolog City aged 60 and above

items: Birth Certificate or Baptismal Certificate
Income Tax Return (if any)
Certificate of Residency from the Barangay Captain
Two (2) copies of 1x1 ID picture
Accomplished membership information sheet (c/o the Senior Citizen Center)
Affidavit of Loss
Barangay or police blotter

procedures.providerAction: Interview the senior citizen to get pertinent information.

procedures.clientAction: Fill out the application form and submit the required documents.
procedures.providerAction: Receive the application form and documents.
procedures.personInCharge: OSCA Head / City Mayor in-charge & staff

procedures.clientAction: Receive the Senior Citizen ID and sign the logbook.
procedures.providerAction: Approve the application, sign the identification card and release the ID.
procedures.personInCharge: OSCA Head / City Mayor in-charge & staff

contact.location: CSWDO, Brgy. Sta. Isabel (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

With the Senior Citizen ID and your old booklet, you can get a purchase slip/booklet for discounts on medicines.

title: Solo Parent ID
description: Apply for a Solo Parent Identification Card at the Dipolog City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO).
department: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Solo parents who are residents of Dipolog City

items: Barangay certification of the solo parent's residency in the barangay for the last six (6) months
Affidavit of circumstance stating the reason for becoming a solo parent
Supporting certificates, e.g. birth certificates of the children, death certificate of the spouse (if applicable), and other appropriate documents
Income Tax Return or any document that establishes the income level of the solo parent
1x1 ID picture

procedures.providerAction: Interview the client to get pertinent information.
Receive the application and other documentary requirements.

procedures.clientAction: Receive the ID and sign the receiving logbook.
procedures.providerAction: Approve the application, sign the identification card and release the ID.

contact.location: CSWDO, Brgy. Sta. Isabel (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

notes: The Solo Parent ID is renewable every three (3) years. Total processing time per the Charter: 41 minutes and 30 seconds. No fee is listed.
The 2022 Charter cites RA 8972. That law has since been expanded by RA 11861 (Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act), so ask the CSWDO whether the requirements have changed.
